street._method: Brokers that disclose a method value BHFL on P/B on FY28E book: Motilal Oswal 2.7x FY28E BVPS; Emkay 2.6x FY28E (Jun-27 target); JM Financial 2.5x FY28E at its Mar-2026 initiation. ICICI Securities used 4x FY27E P/B in Feb-2026.

events.title: IPO and listing
events.detail: ₹6,560 cr IPO at ₹70 (₹3,560 cr fresh, ₹3,000 cr offer for sale by Bajaj Finance), subscribed 63.6x; listed at ₹150 and closed at the ₹165 upper circuit; ₹181.5 the next day.

events.title: Bajaj Finance sells ~2% in a bulk deal
events.detail: 16.66 cr shares; stake 88.70% → 86.70%. Stock fell ~9% to a then-record low of ₹94.90.

events.title: Float deadline extended to Sep-2029
events.detail: Securities Contracts (Regulation) Amendment Rules, 2026 revised the market-cap thresholds; BHFL now has until 15-Sep-2029 to reach 25% public shareholding (was Sep-2027).

events.title: Q4FY26: PAT +14% (+20% before a prior-year tax credit)
events.detail: AUM +23% to ₹1,40,706 cr; NIM −12bp QoQ to 3.8%; credit cost 19bp incl. stronger Stage 2 cover.

events.title: Q1FY27 and FY27 assessment; AGM
events.detail: Record AUM addition (₹8,918 cr), PAT +23%, NIM −14bp QoQ; FY27: AUM +21-23%, NIM −20-25bp, credit cost 10-15bp, ROE 12-13%. AGM sought omnibus approval for up to ₹12,500 cr of loan transfers to Bajaj Finance.
events.src: Q1FY27 presentation and call; Annual Report FY2025-26 (AGM notice)

events.title: Parent: 'no hurry' to sell down
events.detail: Bajaj Finance: 'We are at 86.7%. We will go down to 75%, while we have time and we are in no hurry.'

events.title: Bajaj Finance board to consider its own equity raise
events.detail: The parent noticed a QIP and/or preferential issue (size not given), weeks after calling BHFL dilution its 'first protocol' for capital. That lowers the pressure to sell BHFL shares quickly.

industry.competition: Prime home loans are priced by banks; BT-out goes mostly to public-sector banks, then HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank. BHFL's home-loan attrition ~20% a year, of which BT-out ~10% (Q4FY26 call).
industry.peerValuation: JM Financial (Mar-2026): prime HFCs (LIC Housing, PNB Housing) at 0.5-0.9x FY28E BVPS and affordable HFCs at 1.3-1.9x, vs BHFL ~2.3x.
industry.src: Q1FY27 and Q4FY26 calls; JM Financial initiation (23-Mar-2026)

critiques: Valuation already prices in the medium-term growth and returns
Motilal Oswal (Neutral), JM Financial and Emkay (Add with ≤8% upside)
A prime HFC at ~2.3-2.5x FY28E book vs 0.5-0.9x for other prime HFCs
NIM pressure from banks in prime home loans and run-off of the high-yield book
ICICI Securities, Motilal Oswal, JM Financial
Stake-sale overhang: ~11.7% still to be sold by the parent
gaps: Product-level yields and spreads are not disclosed (only Sambhav target yields of 9-13%); our NIM is a single blended line.
Quarterly NIM, opex ratio, credit cost and ROE for some quarters are only in charts; we use the quarters confirmed in text.
Jun-2025 product AUM derived from the mix chart (rounded); FY20 balance sheet and cash flow restored as Screener ×10 (±₹10 cr).
Per-share history before FY25 is on Screener's adjusted share basis (~781 cr shares), not the shares then in issue; we do not use it.

No published consensus EPS; street figures are from Motilal Oswal, Emkay and JM Financial tables. Methods for 10 of 13 brokers not disclosed in our sources; reasons behind the Sell/Reduce calls (HSBC, DAM, Ambit) not captured.
Timing, size, price and route (offer for sale, block deals or a fresh issue) of the remaining 11.7% sell-down are not announced.
Index and passive-flow effects of a higher free float are not quantified.
Share count after Mar-2026 ESOP allotments (an allotment was notified in Sep-2026) not checked; we use 833.2 cr.
Risk-weighted assets by product are not disclosed, so we cannot forecast CRAR; we track leverage and equity ÷ AUM instead.
MD's absolute pay (only the ratio to the median) not captured.
conflicts: ICICI Securities: BusinessToday's 1-Aug-2026 table lists Buy ₹125; a search summary attributed an Add ₹95 call to it. We use the table and flag the doubt.
IPO subscription: 63.6x (exchange data) vs ~67x (Business Standard, by value).
Peak price: ₹181.5 (17-Sep-2024 upper-circuit close; BusinessToday) vs Screener's weekly series (₹163.7 first week). We quote ₹181.5.
Our Bajaj Finance initiation assumed the sell-down to 75% in two tranches by H1FY28 at ₹82; the deadline is in fact 15-Sep-2029 and the parent says it is in no hurry.
Equity capital: Screener ₹8,329 cr vs paid-up ₹8,332.33 cr in the annual report (shares held by the ESOP trust are netted as treasury shares).
